# Flip Clock

> A beautiful, free online split-flap (airport-style) flip clock that works on any screen — PC, Mac, tablet and mobile.

## What it does

- Displays the current local time as a split-flap flip clock with smooth card animations
- Reads time automatically from the user's device — no setup needed
- Detects the user's browser language and shows the date in that language automatically
- Supports 12-hour and 24-hour formats with a toggle button (preference saved in browser)
- Keeps the screen awake using the Wake Lock API (no screensaver interruptions)
- Works in fullscreen mode with hidden cursor
- Fully responsive — adapts to any screen size including phones in portrait and landscape

## Who it's for

Anyone who wants a beautiful clock on their screen: at a desk, on a TV, on a tablet used as a wall clock, or on a phone as a bedside clock.

## Access

- Web: https://flipclock.day/
- No account, no install, no ads — open the URL and it works

## Technical details

- Single HTML file, no dependencies except Google Fonts (Bebas Neue)
- Uses CSS 3D transforms for the flip animation
- Uses navigator.wakeLock API to prevent screen sleep
- Uses toLocaleDateString() for automatic locale-aware date formatting
- Hosted on Cloudflare Pages
